con:testCase.name: Dom00123-Push-EDELIVERY-1686-Manual-The message receive failure notifications are not sent
con:testCase.con:description:

2. Reload PMode with changed value
3. Change filters order for Receiver - put JMS at top position
4. Submit a message. In this test to standard message with attachment optional property was added: <ns:Property name="CharacterSet"> #UTF-8</ns:Property> This incorrect Charset should result with exception raised in checkCharset method.
5. Confirm " #UTF-8 is not a valid Charset" message in domibus.log for Sender
6. Validate that in queue jms/domibus.backend.jms.errorNotifyConsumer error message is present with correct content.
7. Reset Pmode and filtering to default.

con:testCase.name: Dom00124-Push-EDELIVERY-1721-Manual-HTTPClientPolicy: the connection and the receive timeout are hard coded
con:testCase.con:description:
1. In domibus-configuration.xml file for Sender add/change values for properties connectionTimeout and receiveTimeout to values: <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.connectionTimeout">2</prop> <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.receiveTimeout">2</prop> Now sending message with big attachment should fail with timeout error.
2. Restart Sender
3. Sent Submit message.
4. Confirm "java.net.SocketTimeoutException: SocketTimeoutException invoking http://localhost:8180/domibus/services/msh: Read timed out" error message is present in domibus.log for Sender.
5. In domibus-configuration.xml file for Sender increase values for properties connectionTimeout and receiveTimeout to values: <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.connectionTimeout">200000</prop> <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.receiveTimeout">200000</prop>
6. Restart Sender
7. Sent Submit message once again (with changed messageID)
8. Validate message was received this time
9. Change back configuration to previous state.

con:config.script: Domibus.changePropertyAtRuntime("C2", "domibus.dispatcher.connectionTimeout", "2", context, log); Domibus.changePropertyAtRuntime("C2", "domibus.dispatcher.receiveTimeout", "2", context, log);
Domibus.checkNumberOfLinesToSkipInLogFile("C2","domibus.log", log, context, testRunner)

con:config.script: Domibus.checkNumberOfLinesToSkipInLogFile("C2","security.log", log, context, testRunner)
testRunner.testCase.setPropertyValue( "username","userAC"+(new Date().format("ddHHmmss"))); log.info "Value set."
def username=testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue("username"); Domibus.addAdminConsoleUser("C2",context,log,"Default","ROLE_USER",username);
def username=testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue("username"); Domibus.insertWrongPassword("C2",context,log,username,5);
def username=testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue("username"); Domibus.removeAdminConsoleUser("C2",context,log,"Default",username);

con:testCase.name: Dom00423-Pull-EDELIVERY-1686-Manual-The message receive failure notifications are not sent
con:testCase.con:description:
1. Change attributes for errorHandling in PMode file for Receiver <errorHandlings> <errorHandling name="demoErrorHandling" errorAsResponse="true" businessErrorNotifyProducer="true" businessErrorNotifyConsumer="true" deliveryFailureNotifyProducer="true"/> </errorHandlings>
2. Reload PMode with changed value
3. Change filters order for Receiver - put JMS at top position
4. Submit a message. In this test to standard message with attachment optional property was added: <ns:Property name="CharacterSet"> #UTF-8</ns:Property> This incorrect Charset should result with exception raised in checkCharset method.
5. Confirm " #UTF-8 is not a valid Charset" message in domibus.log for Sender
6. Validate that in queue jms/domibus.backend.jms.errorNotifyConsumer error message is present with correct content.
7. Reset Pmode and filtering to default.

con:config.script: PModeUtils.uploadPmode("receiver","special","\\errorNotif\\red\\domibus-pmode-red.xml",context,log);

con:testCase.name: Dom00424-Pull-EDELIVERY-1721-Manual-HTTPClientPolicy: the connection and the receive timeout are hard coded
con:testCase.con:description:
1. In domibus-configuration.xml file for Sender add/change values for properties connectionTimeout and receiveTimeout to values: <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.connectionTimeout">2</prop> <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.receiveTimeout">2</prop> Now sending message with big attachment should fail with timeout error.
2. Restart Sender
3. Sent Submit message.
4. Confirm "java.net.SocketTimeoutException: SocketTimeoutException invoking http://localhost:8180/domibus/services/msh: Read timed out" error message is present in domibus.log for Sender.
5. In domibus-configuration.xml file for Sender increase values for properties connectionTimeout and receiveTimeout to values: <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.connectionTimeout">200000</prop> <prop key="domibus.dispatcher.receiveTimeout">200000</prop>
6. Restart Sender
7. Sent Submit message once again (with changed messageID)
8. Validate message was received this time
9. Change back configuration to previous state.

con:config.script: Domibus.changePropertyAtRuntime("C3", "domibus.dispatcher.connectionTimeout", "1", context, log); Domibus.changePropertyAtRuntime("C3", "domibus.dispatcher.receiveTimeout", "1", context, log);
Domibus.checkNumberOfLinesToSkipInLogFile("C3","domibus.log", log, context, testRunner)

""", log, testRunner)

con:config.script: Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Create general DB schemas. - Configure Multitenancy for C2 and C3 (enable plugin security, create domain properties file, create domain schema ...) - Domains "domibus_C2Dom1" and "domibus_C2Dom2" are configured for C2. - Domains "domibus_C3Dom1" and "domibus_C3Dom2" are configured for C3. - Create plugin users on C2: "userC1C2Dom1" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C2Dom1", "userC1C2Dom2" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C2Dom2". - Create plugin users on C3: "userC4C3Dom1" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C3Dom1", "userC4C3Dom2" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C3Dom2". - Set properties (multitenancyModeC2,multitenancyModeC3) to (2,2). - Certificate configured on domain "domibus_C2Dom1" is present in the truststore of domain "domibus_C3Dom1" and "domibus_C3Dom2". """, log, testRunner)
// TODO: automate Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ Enable plugin security for both C2 and C3. """, log, testRunner)
// TODO: automate Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ Check that a folder is created in C3 for each message inside each targeted domain folder """, log, testRunner)

Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Configure Multitenancy for C2 (enable plugin security, create domain properties file, create domain schema ...) - Domain "domibus_C2Dom1" is configured for C2. - Multitenany is not configured for C3. - Create plugin authentication user on C2: "userC1C2Dom1" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C2Dom1". - Create plugin authentication user on C3: "userC4" linked to "finalRecipient". - Set properties (multitenancyModeC2,multitenancyModeC3) to (1,0). - Certificate configured in default domain is not present in the truststore of C3. """, log, testRunner)
// TODO: automate Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ Enable plugin security for C2. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - In file "domibus_C2Dom1-domibus.properties" set property "domibus.UI.title.name" to "New AC Title". """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Restart domibus C2. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualCheck("""\ - UI title takes the new value when domain "domibus_C2Dom1" is selected. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - In file "domibus_C3Dom2-domibus.properties" set property "domibus.msh.pull.cron" to a faster frequency than the default. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Restart domibus C3. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualCheck("""\ - Check that pull requests for domain "domibus_C3Dom2" occurs occording to the new set value. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - In file "domibus_C2Dom1-domibus.properties" set property "domibus.proxy.enabled" to "true". """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Restart domibus C2. """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualCheck("""\ - Proxy is enabled for domain "domibus_C2Dom1". """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - In file "domibus_C2Dom1-domibus.properties" set property "domibus.sendMessage.messageIdPattern" to "^[A-Z]*$". """, log, testRunner)
Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Restart domibus C2. """, log, testRunner)

con:config.script: Domibus.showPopUpForManualConfigurationChange("""\ - Create general DB schemas. - Configure Multitenancy for C2 and C3 (enable plugin security, create domain properties file, create domain schema ...) - Domains "domibus_C2Dom1" and "domibus_C2Dom2" are configured for C2. - Domains "domibus_C3Dom1" and "domibus_C3Dom2" are configured for C3. - Create plugin users on C2: "userC1C2Dom1" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C2Dom1", "userC1C2Dom2" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C2Dom2". - Create plugin users on C3: "userC4C3Dom1" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C3Dom1", "userC4C3Dom2" linked to "originalSender" and domain "domibus_C3Dom2". - Set properties (multitenancyModeC2,multitenancyModeC3) to (2,2). - Certificate configured on domain "domibus_C2Dom1" is only present in the truststore of domain "domibus_C3Dom2". """, log, testRunner)

con:testCase.name: DomA10-Plugin user password imminent expiration - custom dates

con:config.script:
UserImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentFirstDay" ) UserImminenLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminenLastDay" )
UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentLastDay" )
def side="Blue" def domainValue="Default" def passwordAC=context.expand('${#Project#adminDefaultPassword}') def userRoleUser="ROLE_USER" def userRoleAdmin="ROLE_ADMIN" def originalUser="urn:oasis:names:tc:ebcore:partyid-type:unregistered:C1"
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, UserImminentBeforeFirstDay, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserImminentFirstDay, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, UserImminenLastDay, passwordAC)
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, UserDefaultImminentFirstDay, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserDefaultImminentLastDay, passwordAC, originalUser)

UserImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentFirstDay" ) UserImminenLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminenLastDay" )
UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentLastDay" )
def passwordPolicyExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyExpiration}') as Integer def passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration}') as Integer def alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays}') as Integer def alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays}') as Integer
log.info "Plugin value set for passwordPolicyExpiration: " + passwordPolicyExpiration log.info "Plugin value set for alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays: " + alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays log.info "Plugin value set for passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration: " + passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration
def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) // this sql update is for MySQL server def sqlQueriesList = [ "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserImminentBeforeFirstDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserImminentFirstDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration ) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserImminenLastDay + "'", //DEFAULT PASSWORD "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDefaultImminentFirstDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDefaultImminentLastDay + "'", "commit" ] as String[] test.executeListOfQueriesOnBlue(sqlQueriesList)
test.finalize()

con:config.script:
UserImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentFirstDay" ) UserImminenLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminenLastDay" )
UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentLastDay" )
def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserImminentBeforeFirstDay, null, null, null, 0) test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserImminentFirstDay, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_IMMINENT_EXPIRATION", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserImminenLastDay, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_IMMINENT_EXPIRATION", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay, null, null, null, 0) test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserDefaultImminentFirstDay, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_IMMINENT_EXPIRATION", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserDefaultImminentLastDay, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_IMMINENT_EXPIRATION", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.finalize()

UserImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentFirstDay" ) UserImminenLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminenLastDay" )
UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentFirstDay" ) UserDefaultImminentLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultImminentLastDay" )
def side="Blue" def domainValue="Default"
Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserImminentBeforeFirstDay) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserImminentFirstDay) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserImminenLastDay) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserDefaultImminentBeforeFirstDay) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserDefaultImminentFirstDay) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserDefaultImminentLastDay)

con:testCase.name: DomA11-Plugin user password expiration reached - custom dates

con:config.script:
UserExpiredFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpiredFirstDay" ) UserExpiredLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpiredLastDay" ) UserDayAfterExpiredDate = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDayAfterExpiredDate" )
UserDefaultExpiredFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultExpiredFirstDay" ) UserDefaultExpiredLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultExpiredLastDay" ) UserDefaultDayAfterExpiredDate = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultDayAfterExpiredDate" )
def side="Blue" def domainValue="Default" def passwordAC=context.expand('${#Project#adminDefaultPassword}') def userRoleUser="ROLE_USER" def userRoleAdmin="ROLE_ADMIN" def originalUser="urn:oasis:names:tc:ebcore:partyid-type:unregistered:C1"
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, UserExpiredFirstDay, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserExpiredLastDay, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, UserDayAfterExpiredDate, passwordAC)
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserDefaultExpiredFirstDay, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, UserDefaultExpiredLastDay, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserDefaultDayAfterExpiredDate, passwordAC, originalUser)

UserExpiredFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpiredFirstDay" ) UserExpiredLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpiredLastDay" ) UserDayAfterExpiredDate = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDayAfterExpiredDate" )
UserDefaultExpiredFirstDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultExpiredFirstDay" ) UserDefaultExpiredLastDay = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultExpiredLastDay" ) UserDefaultDayAfterExpiredDate = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserDefaultDayAfterExpiredDate" )
def passwordPolicyExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyExpiration}') as Integer def passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration}') as Integer def alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays}') as Integer def alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays}') as Integer
log.info "Plugin value passwordPolicyExpiration: " + passwordPolicyExpiration log.info "Plugin value alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays: " + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays log.info "Plugin value passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration: " + passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration
def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) // this sql update is for MySQL server def sqlQueriesList = [ "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserExpiredFirstDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserExpiredLastDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDayAfterExpiredDate + "'", //DEFAULT PASSWORD "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration +1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDefaultExpiredFirstDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDefaultExpiredLastDay + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserDefaultDayAfterExpiredDate + "'", "commit" ] as String[] test.executeListOfQueriesOnBlue(sqlQueriesList)
test.finalize()

con:testCase.name: DomA14-Plugin user password expiration parameters set to 0 - expiration disabled

con:config.script:
UserImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentExpiration" ) UserExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpired" ) UserVeryExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserVeryExpired" ) AdminImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminImminentExpiration" ) AdminExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminExpired" ) AdminVeryOldExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminVeryOldExpired" )
def side="Blue" def domainValue="Default" def passwordAC=context.expand('${#Project#adminDefaultPassword}') def userRoleUser="ROLE_USER" def userRoleAdmin="ROLE_ADMIN" def originalUser="urn:oasis:names:tc:ebcore:partyid-type:unregistered:C1"
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserImminentExpiration, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserExpired, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserVeryExpired, passwordAC, originalUser)
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, AdminImminentExpiration, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, AdminExpired, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, AdminVeryOldExpired, passwordAC)

UserImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentExpiration" ) UserExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpired" ) UserVeryExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserVeryExpired" ) AdminImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminImminentExpiration" ) AdminExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminExpired" ) AdminVeryOldExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminVeryOldExpired" )
def passwordPolicyExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyExpiration}') as Integer def passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration}') as Integer def alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays}') as Integer def alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays}') as Integer
log.info "Plugin value set for passwordPolicyExpiration: " + passwordPolicyExpiration log.info "Plugin value set for alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays: " + alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays log.info "Plugin value set for passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration: " + passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration
def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) // this sql update is for MySQL server def sqlQueriesList = [ "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserImminentExpiration + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserExpired + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays + 1 ) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserVeryExpired + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + AdminImminentExpiration + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + AdminExpired + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays + 1 ) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + AdminVeryOldExpired + "'", "commit" ] as String[] test.executeListOfQueriesOnBlue(sqlQueriesList)
test.finalize()

con:config.script:
UserImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentExpiration" ) UserExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpired" ) UserVeryExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserVeryExpired" ) AdminImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminImminentExpiration" ) AdminExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminExpired" ) AdminVeryOldExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminVeryOldExpired" )
def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserImminentExpiration, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_IMMINENT_EXPIRATION", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserExpired, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_EXPIRED", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", UserVeryExpired, null, null, null, 0) test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", AdminImminentExpiration, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_IMMINENT_EXPIRATION", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", AdminExpired, "PLUGIN_PASSWORD_EXPIRED", "SUCCESS", "LOW") test.verifyUserAlerts("Blue", AdminVeryOldExpired, null, null, null, 0) test.finalize()

UserImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentExpiration" ) UserExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpired" ) UserVeryExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserVeryExpired" ) AdminImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminImminentExpiration" ) AdminExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminExpired" ) AdminVeryOldExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminVeryOldExpired" ) def side="Blue" def domainValue="Default"
Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserImminentExpiration) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserExpired) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, UserVeryExpired) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, AdminImminentExpiration) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, AdminExpired) Domibus.removePluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, AdminVeryOldExpired)

con:testCase.name: DomA15-Plugin user password expiration parameters set to 0 - default user - expiration disabled

con:config.script:
UserImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentExpiration" ) UserExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpired" ) UserVeryExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserVeryExpired" ) AdminImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminImminentExpiration" ) AdminExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminExpired" ) AdminVeryOldExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminVeryOldExpired" )
def side="Blue" def domainValue="Default" def passwordAC=context.expand('${#Project#adminDefaultPassword}') def userRoleUser="ROLE_USER" def userRoleAdmin="ROLE_ADMIN" def originalUser="urn:oasis:names:tc:ebcore:partyid-type:unregistered:C1"
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserImminentExpiration, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserExpired, passwordAC, originalUser) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleUser, UserVeryExpired, passwordAC, originalUser)
Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, AdminImminentExpiration, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, AdminExpired, passwordAC) Domibus.addPluginUser(side, context, log, domainValue, userRoleAdmin, AdminVeryOldExpired, passwordAC)

UserImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserImminentExpiration" ) UserExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserExpired" ) UserVeryExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "UserVeryExpired" ) AdminImminentExpiration = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminImminentExpiration" ) AdminExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminExpired" ) AdminVeryOldExpired = testRunner.testCase.getPropertyValue( "AdminVeryOldExpired" )
def passwordPolicyExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyExpiration}') as Integer def passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration = context.expand('${#TestCase#passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration}') as Integer def alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays}') as Integer def alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays = context.expand('${#TestCase#alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays}') as Integer
log.info "Plugin value set for passwordPolicyExpiration: " + passwordPolicyExpiration log.info "Plugin value set for alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays: " + alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays log.info "Plugin value set for passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration: " + passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration
def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) // this sql update is for MySQL server def sqlQueriesList = [ "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserImminentExpiration + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserExpired + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays + 1 ) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + UserVeryExpired + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration - alertPasswordImminentExpirationDelayDays + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + AdminImminentExpiration + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration + 1) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + AdminExpired + "'", "update tb_authentication_entry set default_password = true, password_change_date = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL " + (passwordPolicyDefaultPasswordExpiration + alertPasswordExpiredDelayDays + 1 ) + " DAY) where USERNAME = '" + AdminVeryOldExpired + "'", "commit" ] as String[] test.executeListOfQueriesOnBlue(sqlQueriesList)
test.finalize()

con:testCase.name: Dom00908-LoadTest-Manual-Too many messages to delete at once
con:testCase.con:description:
Update 26.01.2020: - Error in log not present even when retension counters set to 5000 and logs check fails:
def logValueList = ["DEFAULT.retentionWorkerJob threw an exception", "org.quartz.SchedulerException: Job threw an unhandled exception", "See nested exception: org.springframework.transaction.UnexpectedRollbackException: JTA transaction unexpectedly rolled back", "maybe due to a timeout", "nested exception is javax.transaction.RollbackException: Prepare: NO vote"]
Domibus.checkLogFile("C3","domibus.log", logValueList, log, context, testRunner)
- log level for eu.domibus.common.services.impl.MessageRetentionDefaultService should be set to DEBUG
------------ This test needs execution manual checks for errors in log files.
Steps 1. Add two new parameters to domibus-configuration.xml file for Receiver message.retention.downloaded.max.delete=1000 message.retention.not_downloaded.max.delete=1000
2. Run load tests defined in this test step.
3. Turn off Receiver for X minutes (when X is more than retentions time) and after restart observe "Messages" page of Admin Panel to see how messages are being deleted (check number of deleted messages, deleting should stop after some time)
4. Search in domibus.log file of Receiver for errors like in example string: DEFAULT.retentionWorkerJob threw an exception. org.quartz.SchedulerException: Job threw an unhandled exception. [See nested exception: org.springframework.transaction.UnexpectedRollbackException: JTA transaction unexpectedly rolled back (maybe due to a timeout); nested exception is javax.transaction.RollbackException: Prepare: NO vote]
5. Shutdown Receiver
6. Change parameters defined in step 1, for example set values to: <prop key="message.retention.downloaded.max.delete">3</prop> <prop key="message.retention.not_downloaded.max.delete">5</prop>
7. Start Receiver again
8. Observe "Domibus - Messages Log:" to see if correct number of messages are being deleted (3 downloaded + 5 undownloaded each minute)
9. Shutdown Receiver
10. Comment parameters defined in step 1.
11. Start Receiver again
12. Observe "Domibus - Messages Log:" to see if correct number of messages are being deleted (default 50 downloaded + default 50 undownloaded each minute)

con:config.script: def test = new Domibus(log,null,context) test.countCurrentMessagesNumber(testRunner);
